name: Ghostly Possession
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has flying.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by enchanted creature.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by enchanted creature.

needs.what: a continuous static that prevents all (combat) damage a matching permanent would DEAL, e.g. a `prevent_damage` static with a direction key (`dealt: "by"` / `"to_and_by"`) read alongside `affects: {attached: true}` and `combat_only: true`, so an Aura can stop combat damage dealt both to and by the enchanted creature for as long as it is attached
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `prevent_damage` static (with `prevent_all` and `combat_only`) only answers damage dealt TO the matched permanent (`prevents_all_damage` checks the recipient). `prevent_damage_permanent` can face `by`/`to_and_by` but is a one-shot op with only `this_turn`/`until_your_next_turn` durations and no combat-only narrowing, not a continuous Aura static. `damage_source` filters the dealer only on `replace_damage`, which requires `damage_multiplier` of 2 or more and so cannot prevent.
